mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pnt_transaction WHERE type = 'EXPIRE' AND biz_id = #{bizId}

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.type, t.amount, t.balance_after, t.biz_source, t.biz_id, t.expire_at, t.remark, t.simulated, t.created_at FROM pnt_transaction t WHERE t.type = 'EARN' AND t.expire_at IS NOT NULL AND t.expire_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pnt_transaction x WHERE x.type = 'EXPIRE' AND x.biz_id = CAST(t.id AS CHAR) ) ORDER BY t.expire_at ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, type, amount, balance_after, biz_source, biz_id, expire_at, remark, simulated, created_at FROM pnt_transaction
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
